prediction.sql: WITH school_metrics AS (SELECT frpm."County Name" AS County, frpm."School Name" AS "School Name", frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS FreeRate, frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS FreeMealCount, frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS TotalEnrollment, schools.Charter AS Charter, schools.GSserved AS GradesServed, satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite AS TotalSATScore FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode AND satscores.rtype = 'S' WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0), county_avg AS (SELECT "County Name" AS County, AVG("Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)") AS CountyAverageFreeRate FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 GROUP BY "County Name"), ranked AS (SELECT sm.County AS County, sm."School Name" AS "School Name", sm.FreeRate AS FreeRate, sm.FreeMealCount AS FreeMealCount, sm.TotalEnrollment AS TotalEnrollment, sm.Charter AS Charter, sm.GradesServed AS GradesServed, sm.TotalSATScore AS TotalSATScore, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.County ORDER BY sm.FreeRate DESC) AS CountyRank FROM school_metrics AS sm) SELECT r.County AS County, r."School Name" AS "School Name", r.FreeRate AS HighestFreeRate, r.FreeMealCount AS FreeMealCount, r.TotalEnrollment AS TotalEnrollment, CASE WHEN r.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN r.Charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS IsCharterSchool, r.GradesServed AS GradesServed, CASE WHEN r.TotalSATScore IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN r.TotalSATScore < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN r.TotalSATScore <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS SATPerformance, ca.CountyAverageFreeRate AS CountyAverageFreeRate, r.FreeRate - ca.CountyAverageFreeRate AS DeviationFromCountyAverage FROM ranked AS r JOIN county_avg AS ca ON ca.County = r.County WHERE r.CountyRank = 1 ORDER BY r.FreeRate DESC LIMIT 1
